title: sebastiania corniculata var. prostrata
intro:
Sebastiania corniculata var. prostrata, commonly known as Brazilian Pepper Tree or Brazilian Pepper Shrub, is a plant species in the Euphorbiaceae family, characterized by its shrub-like appearance with small, greenish-white flowers.

It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant health benefits, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body.

The therapeutic actions of Sebastiania corniculata var. prostrata include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can be used to treat various health conditions such as pain, wounds, and infections.

The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
